title: kithd: peer discovery background task
description:
Background task that runs at startup and periodically, probes all tailnet peer IPs for kithd instances, and upserts them as contacts.

What: spawn_discovery_task() in kithd/src/discovery.rs, called once from kithd startup.

Algorithm:
1. Add to discovery.rs:
   pub fn spawn_discovery_task(
     tslocal: Arc<TailscaleClient>,
     store: Arc<Mutex<Store>>,
     port: u16,
     owner_user_id: String,
   )
   Spawns a tokio task. Never returns an error (log and continue on failures).

2. The spawned task runs:
   loop {
     run_discovery_round(&tslocal, &store, port, &owner_user_id).await;
     sleep(interval).await;  // interval from KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS env var, default 300
   }

3. run_discovery_round():
   a. Call tslocal.status().await. On error: log warning and return (will retry next round).
   b. Call status.status_peers() to get Vec<&PeerNode>. Skip any peer whose user_id == owner_user_id.
   c. Group peers by user_id: HashMap<user_id, Vec<Vec<String>>> where inner Vec is tailscale_ips lists.
      (One user may have multiple Tailscale nodes — laptop, server, etc.)
   d. For each unique user_id:
      - Try each node's IPs in order (first IP of first node, first IP of second node, etc.)
      - For each IP: call probe_peer(ip, port).await
      - On first Some(peer_session) found: call upsert_discovered_contact and break
      - If no IP responds: log at debug level (normal — many peers won't run kithd)
   e. For upsert: acquire store lock, call contacts().upsert_discovered_contact(
       peer_session.owner_user_id,
       peer_session.owner_login,
       peer_session.mailbox_host,
       peer_session.owner_display_name.as_deref(),
       unix_now()
     ), drop lock.
   f. After all users processed: log at info level 'discovery round complete: N peers found'

4. Wire into kithd/src/main.rs: after store and tslocal are initialized (before the HTTP listener loop), call spawn_discovery_task(tslocal.clone(), store.clone(), config.port, owner_id.clone()).

5. KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS: parse from env in Config. Default 300. Min 60 (clamp below 60 to 60 to prevent hammering).

6. Tests:
   - Test 1 'round finds one peer': mock tslocal returning 2 nodes for user uid-bob; first IP probe returns Some(PeerSession); assert upsert_discovered_contact called once for uid-bob.
   - Test 2 'skips self': peer node user_id == owner_user_id; assert no probe attempted.
   - Test 3 'no kithd on any IP': all probes return None; assert no upsert, no panic.
   - Test 4 'tslocal error': status() returns Err; assert round returns cleanly, no panic.

Defensive programming rules:
- All errors are logged and swallowed — discovery is best-effort, never fatal
- Never hold store lock during probe_peer (probes are slow, lock is for DB writes only)
- Acquire and drop lock for each upsert individually
- Clamp discovery interval to minimum 60 seconds
- owner_user_id check must happen BEFORE any probe to avoid self-probing
